uncovered_waiver.reason: OMN-14841 is a hand-authored def-B dispatch-entrypoint flip for a re-export COMPUTE node whose provider-backed compute (embed/extract_entities/analyze) lives in omnimemory. The selected set exercises all three real dispatch branches through handle() with an injected deterministic embedding provider; the residual uncovered branches are the defensive Literal-bypass case and the ValueError/Exception error mappers, which cannot be reached with contract-valid requests (Pydantic rejects invalid operations and empty content at construction). Behaviour equivalence to the pre-flip omnimemory NodeSemanticAnalyzerCompute.execute routing is proven separately in tests/test_semantic_analyzer_compute_defb.py, so the waiver is scoped to adequacy measurement, not behaviour proof.
